results.description:
The scariest man in Montana walked into my bakery at five a.m. and ordered black coffee.

He refused every pastry I offered. He didn't smile. He barely spoke.

So naturally, I decided he was my new project.

But my sweet little life is crumbling. My father's bakery is drowning in debt, and the man who owns that debt wants everything I have by Christmas Eve.

Then Ryker Vance decides I belong under his protection.

He's ex-military, hard as winter, and haunted by a promise he couldn't keep. He tells me to stay away.

I don't listen.

Because when that silent, scarred biker finally lets me in, he holds me like I'm the only warm thing left in the world.

Now my enemies are closing in. And the man who swore he'd never care again is ready to burn down this town for me.

Can a broken soldier keep one last promise?

Steamy holiday romance. Sunshine baker. Grumpy ex-military biker. Touch her and die. Small-town Christmas. Guaranteed HEA.
